words.meaning: Prudent and thoughtful insight born from deep reflection.
words.sentence1: He sought an epiphrón to guide his difficult decision.
words.sentence2: True leadership requires an inherent epiphrón in times of crisis.

words.meaning: A state of profound inner peace and philosophical tranquility.
words.sentence1: En medio del caos, encontro el sosiego mirando las estrellas. (In the midst of chaos, he found profound tranquility by looking at the stars.)
words.sentence2: El verdadero conocimiento florece solo cuando hay sosiego en la mente. (True knowledge flourishes only when there is serenity in the mind.)

words.meaning: The luminous state of mental clarity that illuminates complex philosophical truths.
words.sentence1: Cette ancienne doctrine apporte une clarté remarquable sur la condition humaine. (This ancient doctrine brings remarkable clarity to the human condition.)
words.sentence2: Il cherchait la clarté spirituelle loin du bruit du monde moderne. (He sought spiritual clarity far from the noise of the modern world.)

words.meaning: Profound pensiveness and depth of philosophical thought.
words.sentence1: Sein Tiefsinn zeigte sich in jedem Wort, das er sprach. (His depth of thought was evident in every word he spoke.)
words.sentence2: Wir brauchen mehr Tiefsinn in unseren täglichen Gesprächen. (We need more profound thoughtfulness in our daily conversations.)

words.meaning: An awareness of the universe that triggers emotional responses too deep and mysterious for words.
words.sentence1: Sono keshiki ni wa fukai yugen ga kanjirareta. (A deep sense of mysterious grace was felt in that landscape.)
words.sentence2: Kare no shisou wa yugen no seishin ni michiteiru. (His philosophy is filled with the spirit of profound mystery.)

words.meaning: Immediate apprehension of truth without the need for conscious reasoning.
words.sentence1: La sua intuizione filosofica anticipò i tempi di molti secoli. (His philosophical intuition anticipated the times by many centuries.)
words.sentence2: Ascolta la tua intuizione quando cerchi la saggezza interiore. (Listen to your intuition when seeking inner wisdom.)

words.meaning: Transcendent wisdom that integrates moral integrity with universal understanding.
words.sentence1: Guren de zhexue jia baohan zhe shenke de zhihui. (Ancient philosophers contained profound wisdom.)
words.sentence2: Zhihui shi chuanyue kongjian de mingdeng. (Wisdom is a beacon shining through space and time.)

words.meaning: Insightful perception that penetrates to the core of complex matters.
words.sentence1: Geuui haeandeun uri gyohunui gichabi doeeotda. (His insightful wisdom became the foundation of our teachings.)
words.sentence2: Jinshilul chajki wihae haeani pilsujeogida. (Insight is essential in order to find the truth.)

words.meaning: Higher intellect, transcendent wisdom, and spiritual discernment.
words.sentence1: Kaeun kar srachchum panya nung saksia samroub jivit. (Cultivating higher wisdom brings clarity to life.)
words.sentence2: Panya chea kluon samang nou knongchett bruburis. (Wisdom is the true essence residing in the mind of the wise.)

words.meaning: Penetrating mental vision and philosophical understanding of existence.
words.sentence1: Hierdie boek bied diep insig in die menslike natuur. (This book offers deep insight into human nature.)
words.sentence2: Ware wysheid begin met selfrefleksie en ware insig. (True wisdom begins with self-reflection and true insight.)
